behavior: Health compares a fixed whitelist of ten meaningful configuration fields instead of projecting the intersection of current and persisted keys.
Stored-only/current-only fields remain distinguishable; missing industries cannot be erased by omitting that field in the current registry.

A missing historical cadence/mode/timezone/anchor-time snapshot value is recovered only from immutable epoch columns or anchor data. Current omitted cadence uses the loader's documented 24-hour default and is accepted only when the persisted epoch proves equivalence.
Equivalent schedule anchor time spellings are normalized before comparison; mismatches and unprovable values fail closed to UNKNOWN without writes.
